integrity: The displayed theorem is proved analytically from the fixed-size nested-subset maximal-correlation theorem and the two-subvector reduction in the cited source. Numerical finite-table checks are only stress tests and are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers uniform fixed-size parent subsets with independent common-probability Bernoulli thinning. It does not cover unequal retention rates, thinning dependent on the parent label beyond membership, arbitrary dependent nested subset laws, or dependent marks. An equivalent spectral formulation may exist in older association-scheme literature.
title: Exact maximal correlation under Bernoulli thinning of a uniform subset
